decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting line is a multi-model specialist system with heavy engineering and certification investment and long defence procurement cycles, so slow uptake can still be read as temporary and the firm stays committed.

Visibility has slipped from a dedicated page to a mention, but this general interior luminaire line sits at the core of the announced LED and interior lighting direction, and its development and production costs make management reluctant to abandon it.
The microprismatic pendant fits the firm's ergonomic, standards-compliant office lighting strategy and has stayed consistently visible, so continuing it justifies the earlier launch decision.

After the HMI searchlight was dropped, this remaining marine searchlight line carries the firm's public commitment to the marine segment and is likely its LED-era successor, so management will persist with it.
